tools.name: convert_grind_setting
tools.description: Translate a grind setting from one coffee grinder to another. Use whenever a recipe quotes a setting for a grinder the user does not own — "the recipe says 18 clicks on a Comandante, what is that on my Encore?". Grinder names can be written however the user said them ("Fellow Ode", "1Zpresso J-Max")

tools.name: get_grinder_chart
tools.description: Grind settings for one grinder across every brew method. Use this for any question of the form "what grind should I use for my <grinder>", "what setting for French press on a <grinder>", or "how do I dial in my <grinder>". Returns the recommended setting and usable range for espresso, moka pot, Aero

tools.name: dial_in
tools.description: The next grind setting to try after the user brewed and tasted: "I used 18 on my Encore and it was sour", "my espresso is bitter at 4.5 on the Ode". tools.description: Shortlist coffee grinders for someone deciding which one to buy: "which grinder should I get for pour over under $200?", "a quiet grinder for espresso", "best hand grinder for travel". tools.name: list_grinders
tools.description: Every grinder BrewMark supports. Use this to check whether a grinder is covered, or to disambiguate when another tool reports more than one match. Not needed just to look up a name — the other tools accept ordinary names directly.
